title: Localization of an oriented product at a representable triple
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:Y\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $P=X_{\mathrm{Et}}\overleftarrow\times_{S_{\mathrm{Et}}}Y_{\mathrm{Et}}$ be the left oriented product on the triple site of [lem-trf-oriented-product-universal]. For a triple $Z=(U\to V\leftarrow W)$, let $H_Z=h_Z^\#$ be the associated representable sheaf [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Then there is a canonical equivalence over $P$
$$P/H_Z\simeq U_{\mathrm{Et}}\overleftarrow\times_{V_{\mathrm{Et}}}W_{\mathrm{Et}},$$
where the maps to $V_{\mathrm{Et}}$ are induced by $U\to V$ and $W\to V$. Under this equivalence, the slice projection $P/H_Z\to P$ is the localization morphism induced by the three maps $U\to X$, $V\to S$, and $W\to Y$ and their commutativity.
